anchor.semantic_hook: Advancing into new dimensions becomes a physical push through successive spatial portals into an unfamiliar chamber.
anchor.setting: A technology demonstration chamber has a workbench at one end and a short runway leading through a row of freestanding geometric portals. The final portal folds the room into an impossible extra direction while the ordinary furniture remains level. Equipment cases and an empty display plinth stand beside the runway.
anchor.absurd_element: a portal that folds the chamber into an impossible extra spatial direction

inserts.action: pushes a wheeled product case through the final portal, leaning forward with focused entrepreneurial pride

variations.scene_adjust: an unbranded prototype device is secured inside the open product case

inserts.action: crosses the final portal in office clothes, clutching a new briefcase and lifting her chin with newly earned confidence

variations.scene_adjust: an upgraded office chair and a polished desk accessory wait beyond the portal

At its center, one ancient fruit tree grows directly through a large glass hourglass, with roots filling the lower chamber and a heavy crown above. A soup pot, practical tools, and an instrument case are available around the courtyard.
